price_wrong_names: SF RESTAURANT WEEK: price '90' vs key '45'
problems_model: The main menu card is readable. The card at the top right is upside down and partly cut off at the edge, so its items were not transcribed. Wine pairing notes below each course are not menu items and were ignored. The price line '90 per person' and '45 optional wine pairing' are printed without a currency symbol and the '90' and '45' appear to be the only prices shown. The right-side card is cut off and mostly unreadable.
